zh: 新增「共享对话」：在侧栏对话上右键选择「共享…」，按工号、姓名或拼音搜索同事（也可直接输入工号），可用常用群组与最近共享推荐，并复制共享链接。被邀请的人会经数字人平台收到一条应用消息，打开应用后看到邀请横幅，错过的在消息中心接受、拒绝或忽略。成员直接进入同一段对话，每条消息标注发送人，侧栏最上方有可折叠的「共享对话」分类；新的提问按提问人自己的身份和权限执行，同一时间只能一人提问。
en: New shared conversations: right-click a conversation and choose “Share…” to find colleagues by employee ID, name or pinyin (or type an ID), use saved groups and recent suggestions, and copy a share link. Invitees get an app message through the digital human platform and a banner when they open the app, or can respond later from the message center. Members work in the very same conversation with each message labelled by sender, listed in a collapsible “Shared” section at the top of the sidebar; each question runs under the asker’s own identity and permissions, one person at a time.
